SpasiX MT5 — Setup

SpasiX MT5 • BUILD 2026-10-24b • MetaTrader 5 (IC Markets) on Windows

What this version does

Opens full screen with the SpasiX look: the 📈 CHART (candles from MT5, M1–W1, zoom / scroll, your tickets with their average, lots and P/L, S/L, T/P, pending orders, bid / ask, crosshair), 💼 POSITIONS, 👁 MARKET (click a symbol = its chart) and the account cards. It still only reads — there is no trading code yet (that is the next step).

Already set up the first version? Do only this

  • In MT5 remove the old bridge: right-click the chart ▸ Expert list ▸ select KeystoneBridge ▸ Remove.
  • Close the old app. Use SpasiXMT5.exe from now on (you can delete KeystoneMT5.exe).
  • Do steps 2 and 5–7 below with SpasiXBridge.mq5. The 127.0.0.1 setting (step 4) is already done.

1The files

  • SpasiXBridge.mq5 — the bridge for MetaTrader 5
  • SpasiXMT5.exe — the SpasiX MT5 app (put it in its own folder, e.g. C:\SpasiX, not inside MT5)

2Put the bridge into MT5

  • MT5 → File → Open Data Folder → MQL5 → Experts → paste SpasiXBridge.mq5 there, next to the folders.
  • Restart MT5 — it compiles the file and SpasiXBridge appears under Expert Advisors in the Navigator.

3(only if it does not appear) Compile it

  • MT5 → press F4 (MetaEditor) → MQL5 ▸ Experts ▸ double-click SpasiXBridge.mq5 → F7. It must say 0 errors (send a screenshot if not).

4Allow the local link (once)

  • MT5 → Tools → Options → Expert Advisors → tick Allow WebRequest for listed URL → click "+ add new URL" → type http://127.0.0.1 → Enter → OK.
  • "Allow algorithmic trading" can stay OFF — the bridge only reads.

5Start the app

  • Double-click SpasiXMT5.exe. A SpasiX loading screen appears, then the platform opens full screen.
  • First time only: if Windows asks for the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime, click Yes, install it, start the app again. "Windows protected your PC" → More info → Run anyway.

6Start the bridge

  • Drag SpasiXBridge onto ONE chart (e.g. XAUUSD) → OK.
  • The chart's corner says SpasiX: connected to the app; the app turns green and opens the 📈 CHART.

7Using the chart

  • Symbols: the buttons at the top (the ones with tickets first). Timeframes: M1 M5 M15 M30 H1 H4 D1 W1.
  • Mouse wheel = zoom • drag = older candles / up-down • drag the price axis = stretch • double-click or ⟲ AUTO = back to now with the automatic scale.
  • Your tickets: each side's average entry with tickets, lots and P/L (strong line), every ticket faint, S/L red, T/P green, pending orders cyan. Times are MT5 server time.

If something is not right

  • Chart corner "add 127.0.0.1 …" → step 4. "waiting for the SpasiX MT5 app (error 5272)" → the app is not open.
  • The chart says "the chart needs the new bridge" → the old KeystoneBridge is still running: do the blue box at the top.
  • "port 47123 is busy" → the app is already open (close the second one).
